unresolved.why: The 1990s reform did not only split provinces: Statoids records Kadiogo formed from Bazéga, Kadiogo and Oubritenga, Balé from Mouhoun and Sissili, Tuy from Bougouriba and Houet, etc., so many 1984 lines run inside NE atoms. Provinces untouched by such exchanges (e.g. Yatenga = Yatenga+Loroum+Zondoma, Séno = Séno+Yagha) look expressible, but the end date (1995, 1996 or 1997-01 depending on the source) and the completeness of the «formerly» lists are unverified.
unresolved.needs: the creating law of the 15 provinces (1996, number not confirmed) with its department annex, and department atoms (geoBoundaries BFA ADM3, CC BY 4.0)
